scope: Official evidence for successful reference games, not an official popularity ranking of genres.
methodology: The selection combines live Steam concurrent-player snapshots, recent Steam review samples and dated publisher milestones. Their periods and units differ, so they must not be added together or used to rank genres.
Steam evidence is biased toward the Steam PC audience and does not represent the entire console, mobile or global games market.
New releases, major updates, discounts, free promotions and time of day can change concurrent-player and review activity. A snapshot does not establish a sustained trend or causation.
Review counts and positive-review percentages measure submitted reviews, not copies sold or the total player population. English-language cumulative reviews are not all-language totals.
Players, copies sold, revenue, monthly active users and concurrent players are different metrics. In particular, publisher-reported players must not be relabeled as paid sales.
GameplayBorrow is a design interpretation of the reference game's described activity. It is not a claim that the cited popularity metric proves a particular mechanic caused commercial success.

sources.gameplayBorrow: Spend or retain a limited budget, arrange objects for spatial synergies, observe an automatic battle, then revise purchases and placement. The new design should make preparation decisions central rather than choosing cards during combat.
